title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is not a handwritten note. It is typed page 139 of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX (Grothendieck, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), §11.6, filed in cote 136 between handwritten pages on divided-power de Rham complexes and simplicial cohomology. The neighbouring pages have nothing to do with it.

Setting: A is an abelian variety over the fraction field K of a (complete, or henselian) discrete valuation ring with semi-stable reduction. A' is the dual abelian variety. M and M' are the character groups of the toric parts of the special fibres of the Néron models of A and A'. ũ: M → M'^∨ is the monodromy pairing map, injective with finite cokernel by the orthogonality theorem. D_ℓ = Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ.

Goal: define the canonical isomorphism (11.6.2), which identifies the ℓ-primary part of the component group Φ with Ker(ũ_ℓ ⊗ D_ℓ). Since M_ℓ⊗D_ℓ is the inductive limit of the M_n (n running over powers of ℓ), it suffices to give compatible isomorphisms (11.6.4): _nΦ_o ≅ Ker(ũ_n : M_n → M'^∨_n) for n = ℓ^{r+1}, with ũ_n the reduction of ũ_ℓ mod n.

Construction:
- The n-torsion _nA of the Néron model is a flat quasi-finite S-group scheme (2.2.1), because the reduction is semi-stable.
- It carries the canonical filtration _nA ⊃ (_nA^o)^f ⊃ (_nA^o)^t ⊃ 0 (11.6.5). Here f is the 'fixed part' (2.2.3) and t the 'toric part' (5.1). Part 5.1 assumed S complete, which is harmless here; the text notes it extends to henselian S (6.1).
- One sets _nΨ = _nA/(_nA^o)^f (11.6.6). By SGA 3 VI_A 3.2 and VI_B 9.2 this is a flat, separated, quasi-finite S-group scheme, with generic fibre (_nA_K)/(_nA_K)^f.

The page ends there. The continuation compares the special-fibre component group with the kernel of the reduced monodromy map, which is the standard proof of Grothendieck's description of the component group via the monodromy pairing.
errors: No mathematical errors on this page.
'où des isomorphismes canoniques' should read 'ou des isomorphismes canoniques' (meaning 'that is, of the isomorphisms'); this is an original typo or ambiguity.

ideas.what: ℓ-part of the component group of the Néron model identified with the kernel of the monodromy pairing map tensored with Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ, constructed via compatible isomorphisms at finite levels n = ℓ^{r+1}
ideas.modern_name: Grothendieck's description of the component group via the monodromy pairing (Φ ≅ coker of M → M'^∨)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck, SGA 7 I Exp. IX (1967-69, publ. 1972)

ideas.what: Filtration of the quasi-finite flat group scheme _nA by its fixed part and toric part, and the quotient _nΨ = _nA/(_nA^o)^f
ideas.modern_name: Fixed/toric/finite filtration of n-torsion in the semi-stable case

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typescript page (p. 139) of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX, misfiled among the de Rham divided-power notes. Its content is fully published and credited to Grothendieck.
transcription_corrections: The page is typed, not handwritten. It is SGA 7 Exp. IX, p. 139; 457 is the archive foliation number.
'comptatibles' is faithful to the original typo.
In the margin there are blue-ink and pencil marks (a correction bracket near 'grâce à l'hypothèse...') with no mathematical content.
